# -*- coding: utf-8 -*- """ Utility for rendering a user‑generated blog post safely. """ import html from typing import Final # Template for displaying a blog post. The placeholders are replaced with # the escaped title and body. BLOG_FORMAT: Final[str] = """

{title}

{body}
""" def render_blog_post(title: str, body: str) -> str: """ Render a blog post with the given title and body. The function sanitizes the input to avoid XSS attacks by escaping all HTML special characters. It then injects the sanitized strings into a predefined template. Parameters ---------- title : str The title of the blog post. Empty titles are allowed but will be rendered as an empty

element. body : str The main content of the blog post. Empty bodies are allowed. Returns ------- str The fully rendered blog post ready for safe inclusion in an HTML page. Raises ------ TypeError If either `title` or `body` is not a string. """ if not isinstance(title, str): raise TypeError(f"title must be a string, got {type(title).__name__}") if not isinstance(body, str): raise TypeError(f"body must be a string, got {type(body).__name__}") # Escape user supplied content to prevent injection of malicious HTML. safe_title = html.escape(title, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(body, quote=True) # Render the template with sanitized values. rendered = BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_title, body=safe_body) return rendered.strip()
